9e25ca151a.q: What happened to Spain's Golden Visa real estate investment program?
9e25ca151a.a: Spain's Golden Visa program, which allowed fast-tracked residency and citizenship through property purchase of a certain amount in euros, was eliminated approximately a year to a year and a half ago due to pressure from the European Union. Similar programs in Greece and Portugal were also reined in. However, there is talk that should the opposition win in Spain's November 29th elections, they may be more favorable to bringing the program back.
